_comment: Readiness gate for the GPU-heavy Kokoro TTS render. Copy to briefing_gate.json to override. ALL fields optional — built-in defaults apply for anything omitted, and a missing file means 'use defaults', never 'disabled'. Only the 'quality' audio path is gated; 'fast' gTTS is never blocked.
_blocking_processes: Substring, case-insensitive process names. Any match defers the render. 'openmw' already covers Dreamsleeve. Add your game/launcher process names here.
_gpu_busy_threshold_pct: Defer if sustained GPU Device Utilization %% exceeds this (catches games not in the list above). 40 = fairly permissive.
_retry_interval_min: When deferred, re-check this many minutes later.
_giveup_hour: After this local hour, stop retrying for the day and skip to tomorrow (undelivered content rolls into the next run).
